## Why Free Cloud Storage Matters
Free cloud storage has become a staple for everyday digital life. It protects your photos, documents, and projects from hardware failure while giving you instant access from any device. With remote work and hybrid learning still common, having a no‑cost place to keep files safe and shareable is more valuable than ever. The free tiers of 2026 are surprisingly robust, often matching what paid plans offered just a few years ago.
